snippet.title: Witchbrook - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Mossport!🧹 Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! 

Coming to PC, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox on January 28th.

💻 Steam: http://bit.ly/Steam_WB
🟢 Xbox: http://bit.ly/Xbox_WB
🔴 Nintendo Switch: http://bit.ly//Nintendo_WB
🔵 PlayStation: http://bit.ly/PlayStation_WB

Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

Witchbrook will be available in English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Russian, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. Witchbrook will also be available on Game Pass from day one.

Developed by & Published by Chucklefish. Co-developed by Robotality.

https://www.witchbrook.com/
Join the Discord:  https://discord.gg/chucklefish

#Witchbrook #PixelArt #IndieGames #lifesimgames
